This apprenticeship is in revision
A revised version of this has been agreed and is available for information only at present. It will replace the version below for new starts from 1st November 2026 with a funding band of £7,000. Further details of this and other apprenticeships in revision are available in the revisions status report .
This standard included a transition arrangement for the minimum off‑the‑job training requirement for learners starting between 1 August and 31 December 2025.
